text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, Mejiro Dober wants to buy<n>some tea, so
she heads to the mall to<n>sample different varieties.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This Darjeeling is good... It has a<n>nice, mellow
aftertaste and is so<n>fragrant as it goes down.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, girl! I see you like my tea!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? You're the one who brewed<n>this?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was chosen to give out<n>samples for my
talents. My method<n>of making world-changing tea
has<n>been wildly popular!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know there was such a way<n>to brew tea...
Do you happen to, uh,<n>offer lessons for that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So you want to seize the world too?<n>Very well! I'll
teach you everything<n>you need to know!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First, you need to put tea leaves into<n>a warmed
teapot...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Okay! I put the leaves in!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
After you pour the hot water in, close<n>the lid, and
encourage the tea leaves<n>in different languages
while they<n>steep!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Wait... Encourage the leaves in<n>different
languages? What?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
T-tea leaves... become mucho<n>delicioso, s'il vous
plaît...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh... Wo ai ni!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very good! I know it's a little<n>embarrassing,
but the tea leaves<n>appreciate the gesture!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: D-does this really make it taste<n>better?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Try it and see for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sip... Hm?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's delicious!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it? By showing appreciation to<n>the leaves that
have traveled all the<n>way here from abroad—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I see! Doing so lets the leaves steep<n>for just the
right amount of time, thus<n>perfectly drawing out
their flavor! A<n>basic but important step!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Really? I thought it was about<n>Umamusume and tea
coming together<n>across the species barrier...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-I don't know about that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But this helped remind me of the<n>basics. I've been
so busy lately that I<n>forget to let the leaves steep!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The following day, Mejiro Dober's<n>movements are
sharper than usual<n>during training!
